summary: Sekrets can serve a root-enrolled run-only system service without a daemon, with exact UID/unit/argv and explicit profile grants.

schema.detail: No st registry or gateway database migration; root gateway config gains optional program enrollments.

compatibility.detail: New program caller kind and literal program grants. Old gateways reject programs config; install the containing gateway before enrollment. Person/agent/host behavior stays unchanged.

downtime.detail: New standalone gateway install and activation require reviewed host acceptance; duration and runner impact are unqualified. No deployment is performed by this change.

manual.detail: Operator binds actual separate UID/system unit/exact root-pinned signer argv and private runner checkout mapping, provisions search ACLs and mount anchor, creates private signer HOME/key/config, and grants from a login session. New NixOS module is a separate install input.

recovery.detail: Remove program enrollment and grants before reverting the gateway. Never replace the program UID with a person mapping.
